title: graphty assets member, version 1
description: The model files a document's style layers name, embedded exactly as given (assets.md). Normative for what a writer produces. Closed: an unknown member of the member skips the member, and of an entry or a file skips that entry (assets.md, 'Reading' rules 1 and 3). Every file's data is base64 of exactly byteLength bytes; the entry's sha256 is the digest of its file set (assets.md, 'The digest'); all the files of one member hold at most 67,108,864 bytes (64 MB). These three are rules this schema cannot express.

assets.description: One entry per model a layer names. The first entry with a given sha256 carries the files; a later one with the same sha256 (another id, or another URL) carries none and shares them.

id.description: What a layer names in node.model. An id of the form asset:<64 hex digits> is the sha256 itself.

format.description: The main file's format as detected when it was added: glb, gltf, obj, stl or ply for a model, png, jpeg or webp for a picture. A reader detects it again from the bytes.

main.description: The main file's path in the set (inside the zip, for a zip).

source.description: The URL a layer named, when the model or picture came from one: naming it resolves to these files and fetches nothing, unless stored is url.

stored.description: Kept by URL: no files; the asset loads from source when the reader allows it, and a file whose digest is not sha256 is reported (W_MODEL_CHANGED). Absent: the files are embedded.

skipped.description: Parts the model is drawn without (pictures and .mtl files, by their path in the set): a reader applies the same skips before checking. Not in the digest.

path.description: Slash-separated, with no '.', '..' or empty segment, and not one folder every file of the entry shares.

mediaType.description: Informative only: a reader detects every format from the bytes.
